entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. It's just... it's not working at all. I'm so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Rivera, order number VF-8675309.

Thank you, Mark. I have your account pulled up. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 13 days ago. I'm sorry you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device, or is it not meeting your preferences?
Oh, it's a technical fault for sure. It simply won't sync with the app. I've followed all the instructions, charged it fully, restarted my phone... everything. I honestly think it's broken.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. So when you say it's not working, you mean the data isn't transferring to your phone?

Exactly. The screen lights up, but it won't sync, which makes it useless. I feel like I was sent a defective unit. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I saved up for this. I really needed this money if it wasn't going to work.

I completely understand your frustration, Mark, and that is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Since it sounds like a technical issue where the device might be defective, the best course of action is to connect you with our Technical Support team.
Technical support? Can't I just... return it? I'm just so sad about this whole thing. I was really looking forward to using it.

I hear your disappointment, and I want to get this solved for you. For a device that won't sync, our procedure is to have our technical experts troubleshoot it first. They have specialized tools and can determine immediately if the unit is broken. If they confirm it's a defective device, they are authorized to process a warranty replacement for you right away.
Oh. Okay... I guess that's fair. As long as someone can help me get a working one. I just feel so let down.
They absolutely will. This is exactly what they're there for. I'm confident they can get this sorted out for you. I'll transfer you over to them right now. Is that okay?
Yes, that's okay. Thank you, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Mark. Please hold for one moment while I connect you.
